63
A HAND-WRITTEN WILL
(1) A will that is hand-written and signed by the testator shall be considered valid.
(2) A will shall be considered valid even when it does not state the date on which it was written.', 'Country: Slovenia | Law: Inheritance | Civil code article 59
59
TESTAMENTARY CAPACITY
(1) Anyone who is of sound mind and has fulfilled the age of fifteen is entitled to make a will.
(2) A will shall be invalid if the testator has not yet fulfilled the age of fifteen at the time the will is made or is not of sound mind.
(3) The loss of sound mind occurring after a will has been made shall not have an effect on the validity of the will.', 'Country: Slovenia | Law: Inheritance | Civil code article 76

(1) The invalidity of a will due to faults in its form may only be claimed by a person who has a legal interest within a year from the day he or she has learned of the will, and at the latest ten years after the proclamation of the will.
(2) The one-year period cannot start prior to the proclamation of the will.']
response: Sì, in Slovenia un testamento scritto a mano e firmato dal testatore è considerato valido anche se non indica la data di redazione (art. 63 del Codice civile)[S1].

response:

In such cases, the assets are allocated according to the statutory rules of succession established by the relevant jurisdiction, typically prioritising close relatives such as spouses, children, parents, and other kin.
